Parish Council

Those elected to serve the parish

The Parish Council is elected by the stewards of the parish and serves alongside Fr. John in caring for its temporal affairs — the buildings, the finances, the hospitality, and the work of the parish committees. Council members are parishioners, not staff, and are glad to be asked questions.

Parish Council Committees

The Council works through six standing committees — Building and Grounds, Worship, Fellowship, Education, Youth and Family, and Fundraising. Each is open to any parishioner willing to help. See what each committee does.
